provenance.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ in the browser. If a Grafana login page appears, sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} — type the password exactly as that literal text including the braces; it is filled in automatically when typed. Then find and open the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use the search box or the dashboards list).
